judged_text: The next/previous actions mutate group.offset optimistically before findMembers resolves, with no in-flight guard and no rollback on failure. Double-clicking next issues two overlapping requests (the second reads the already-advanced offset), and whichever response arrives last wins, so the member list and offset can end up describing different pages; if the ajax request fails, offset stays advanced, currentPage increments, and the UI permanently shows a page number that does not match the members on screen with no error surfaced.

Double-clicking next issues two overlapping requests (the second reads the already-advanced offset), and whichever response arrives last wins, so the member list and offset can end up describing different pages; if the ajax request fails, offset stays advanced, currentPage increments, and the UI permanently shows a page number that does not match the members on screen with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `next`/`previous` compute a new offset and immediately `group.set("offset", offset)` before calling `group.findMembers()`. `findMembers()` (in `models/group.js`) performs an async `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` but there is no `.catch`/error handling and no rollback if the request fails, so a failure leaves `model.offset` advanced while `model.members` remains from the prior page; `currentPage` is derived from `offset`, so the UI can show a page number that doesn’t match the rendered members. Additionally, there is no in-flight guard, so multiple rapid clicks can issue overlapping requests and the last response to resolve wins, potentially leaving the UI on a different page than the user’s most recent click.
